title: Tet Offensive
summary: On 30 and 31 January 1968, North Vietnamese and National Liberation Front forces attacked targets across South Vietnam, including Saigon, where they breached the outer walls of the US Embassy, and Huế. US and South Vietnamese forces regained the lost ground, but coverage of the fighting weakened US domestic support for the war.

uncertainty.note: The State Department Office of the Historian gives "January 30 and 31" for the first phase; History.com says early on 30 January with entry into Huế on the 31st. Later phases ran into the autumn.

where.modern_name: Ho Chi Minh City (Saigon), Vietnam; attacks were nationwide

importance.justification: A turning point in the Vietnam War that shifted US opinion against the war.

audience_note: Concerns a war with mass civilian and military deaths; stated in general terms.
